# HTTP API

<!-- Generated by docs/gen-api.py from the server's OpenAPI; do not edit by hand. -->

This page is generated by [`docs/gen-api.py`](https://github.com/suyiiyii/alldayrec/blob/main/docs/gen-api.py) from
the server's OpenAPI. Each description is the first sentence of the endpoint function's docstring.

::: info Version
This page follows the server on the main branch. The Docker image `latest` (v0.2.0) is older and lacks the endpoints
added since, such as `/api/stars` and `/api/perf`.
:::

## Authentication

- Every request except `GET /api/health` needs a tenant's token: the header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, or the cookie `token`.
- Open any GET page once with `?token=<token>`: the server sets a cookie valid for a year and redirects (303) to the address without the token.
- Without a valid token, HTTP answers 401 and a WebSocket is closed with 4401.
- When `tenants.json` has a single tenant whose token is empty, there is no authentication.
- The firmware writes (`POST /api/firmware`, `PATCH /api/firmware/{model}/{version}`) also need `X-Firmware-Token: <FIRMWARE_TOKEN>`.

## Not in the tables

- Bodies of raw bytes, which OpenAPI does not describe: the body of `POST /api/chunks` is one whole audio file, the body of `POST /api/firmware` a firmware package.
- What the endpoints answer: the tables give only the requests. The two used when uploading audio: `POST /api/chunks` answers `{"seconds": the piece's seconds, "slice": {…}}`, `GET /api/client-config` answers `{"slice": {…}}`. `slice` holds the seconds per piece the apps cut now (`foreground`, `background`, `screenOff`); while the 实时 (Live) page `/live` is open, `background` and `screenOff` are at most `SLICE_WATCHED_S` (see [Configuration](./configuration.md)).
- `GET /ws`: a WebSocket on which the server pushes the tenant's updates to the web pages.
- The web app's own routes (`/`, `/live`, `/conversations` and so on) and `/assets/*`: see [Web pages and app settings](./web-and-app.md).

## Endpoints

Parameters: `name?` is optional; the parentheses give where it goes (query, path) and its type.

| Method | Description | Parameters |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | One DFU package (`lr.sh pkg`) as the body; the model is the build's own (CONFIG_BT_DIS_MODEL), read by lr_release.py from the build directory the package came from. | `model` (query, string)<br>`version` (query, string)<br>`commit` (query, string)<br>`built` (query, string)<br>`notes` (query, string) |
| `GET` | A model's packages, newest first: the app's firmware page lists them with their notes. | `model` (query, string) |
